primary_unit: enrolled task; attempts and executions are nested
primary_outcomes: exact version and scope binding of recorded decisions
missing_data_policy: Keep missing files, unmatched IDs, unobserved attempts and unknown costs distinct; do not impute zero.
amendment_policy: New protocol version and journal/dataset ID, with reason and actual timestamp; preserve prior snapshots.
notes: Planning only. Not frozen, not externally preregistered, and contains no experimental results.
